answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using time-locked collateral staking rather than a closed garden. To register, each node must lock tokens in an on-chain vault, forcing an attacker to incur verifiable capital costs per forged identity. Slashing contracts trace suspicious behaviors that flare across the violet spectrum of transaction telemetry. However, this mechanism traps productive liquidity, unfairly pricing out legitimate, capital-constrained agents.
